content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV=high - Reserved pool 'resv-pool-eu-3' at 100% GPU utilization. Impacting reserved tenants: AureliaBank (latency spike, queued requests). Autoscaler reported rate-limit errors while scaling up. Incident channel opened.
ben_oncall: acknowledged. I'm on it. @alice_sre can you grab the metrics and check autoscaler health? i'm paged.
alice_sre: pulling dashboards now. seeing sustained queue growth for resv-pool-eu-3 starting ~10:12 UTC. GPU utilization 100%, all 8 reserved GPUs pinned. Autoscaler logs show repeated 429s from cloud quota API at 10:13-10:18.
cara_runtime: confirming: recent rollout of batching changes? not that I can see—runtime traces show long tail latencies from one tenant's sessions, lots of small requests causing continuous scheduling.
derek_support: AureliaBank reporting 500s and "request queued" from their end. They say this started ~10:15 UTC. Their account team on call.
emily_pm: is this the tenant we set reservation guarantees for? they have a 8-GPU reserved contract, yes.
ben_oncall: ok plan: (1) mitigate customer impact immediately (2) contain noisy neighbor (3) unstick autoscaler. Steps: divert new requests for AureliaBank to hosted fallback pool (best effort), throttle non-reserved noisy sessions, and escalate cloud quota with infra.
alice_sre: quick checks: listing reservations and session counts:

```
$ rctl resv list --pool resv-pool-eu-3
pool: resv-pool-eu-3  GPUs=8  active_sessions=412  queued=220
$ rctl sessions --by-tenant AureliaBank | wc -l
active=198  queued=92
$ rctl sessions --by-tenant tenant-xyz | wc -l
active=134  queued=85
```

Many sessions from tenant-xyz (non-enterprise) tying up GPU slots.
cara_runtime: looks like tenant-xyz started a large batched inference job 10:05 UTC. It didn't honor soft quota and created lots of short-lived sessions. Autoscaler attempted to add nodes but cloud API returned 429 rate_limited because we've hit a scaling burst policy.
ben_oncall: Derek, please open a customer bridge with AureliaBank. Jules, loop in sales/AM.
derek_support: on it. bridge invite sent to AureliaBank-SREs + account exec.
jules_sales: joining bridge. putting priority note to legal/ops.
alice_sre: mitigation actions executed:
- set tenant-xyz soft throttle to 10rps (temp)
- evicted long-idle preemptible pods from pool
- enabled prefix-caching for some hot keys
Results: queued count dropped from 220 -> 160 in ~2m, AureliaBank latency improved slightly.
cara_runtime: to be explicit: applying throttle to tenant-xyz will push some sessions back to client with 429. We need to route AureliaBank to hosted fallback while we stabilize.
ben_oncall: mike_enginfra, can infra temporarily bump autoscaler quota or disable burst rate limit for this pool? Doing a manual scale up would help.
mike_enginfra: cloud quotas are managed in central account, I can request emergency override but it takes ~5-10min. Alternative: hot-add a prewarmed node from cold pool into resv-pool-eu-3, no cloud API call. Doing that now.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: starting hot-migration of prewarmed instance (node-45) -> resv-pool-eu-3
alice_sre: node-45 attached. pool GPUs available +8 but runtime placement delayed due to KV cache warmup. Rebalancer in progress.
ben_oncall: good. while warmup happens, continue routing AureliaBank new sessions to hosted fallback. Cara coordinate TTL for fallback.
cara_runtime: setting redirect rule now: new sessions for AureliaBank -> hosted-us-east-fallback (best-effort, encrypted). TTL 15m. Command:

```
$ rctl routing set --tenant AureliaBank --fallback hosted-eu-1 --ttl 900
```

applied.
derek_support: customer bridge on. AureliaBank: "we're seeing a lot of 502s and some requests queued for >30s". I've told them about routing.
emily_pm: we need an RFO later, but for now customer impact note: partial service degradation for AureliaBank from 10:15-ongoing (now mitigated for new sessions).
alice_sre: metrics after actions: queue drop 220 -> 90 in 6m. GPU util down to 86% as node-45 took load. Autoscaler log still showing 429s when trying to scale additional nodes; hot-add solved immediate need.
ben_oncall: next: durable fix: identify why autoscaler hit rate limit (spike of scale calls). Cara, can we change autoscaler backoff to exponential to avoid hitting cloud too hard?
cara_runtime: yes we can. current config uses fixed-interval backoff 10s x 6. I'll flip to exponential and add jitter. will push a config change to staging then prod rollout in 10m after validation.
mike_enginfra: following up on quota: opened emergency ticket with cloud provider. we have a return ETA ~35m.
alice_sre: also found that tenant-xyz was using an older client SDK that didn't use streaming; it created many parallel short sessions. i've filed a follow-up with devex to contact tenant-xyz with recommended best practices and temporary enforcement of session concurrency limits.
ben_oncall: summary so far: customer impact reduced by routing fallback + hot-add node + throttling noisy tenant. Ongoing tasks: 1) follow cloud quota ticket (mike), 2) autoscaler backoff change (cara), 3) support bridge with customer (derek/jules), 4) post-incident RFO and policy changes (alice/emily).
emily_pm: please record exact customer timeline and any SLA credit guidance. I'll start drafting comms.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: mitigation achieved (partial) - pool capacity healthy at 86% and queue trending down. Monitoring for 30m.
ben_oncall: if nothing regresses in 30m we'll start demobilizing. thanks team. I'll raise pager postmortem and assign owners.
alice_sre: filing initial incident ticket and smoke tests. will add logs and commands used.
ben_oncall: closing in 30. keep channel open for updates. :thumbsup:"
